camera.convention: T_pose_rect = T_pose_camera * inverse(R_rect_selected); T_pose_velo = T_pose_cam0 * inverse(calib_cam_to_velo); TF serializes both; CameraInfo P=[K|0], stereo baseline represented once in TF

frames.base_link: defined as KITTI-360 GPS/IMU pose frame; imu_link is identical

motion.source: raw OXTS GNSS/INS Mercator positions and attitudes; not an image/LiDAR-optimized trajectory or independent metrology
motion.timestamps: OXTS packet timestamps by original frame ID; no interpolation
motion.twist: finite differences between neighboring selected poses in body frame; approximate interval averages; zero/unknown for a singleton

velodyne_time.model: -atan2(y,x)/(2*pi)*scan_period_s relative to header; clockwise, forward-facing mid-sweep; modelled, not measured
